Hi Nina / Carlos

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we have a single source of truth going into the POC: 

Summary / success criteria
- Goal: Validate Redwood can serve 99th-percentile page-generation latencies <= 350ms for the Clinical Summary workflow and reduce per-token inference cost by >= 30% vs current baseline.
- Success criteria (agreed):
  1) Latency: 95th/99th p95/p99 under simulated triage load (15 RPS sustained) < 350ms p99.
  2) Accuracy: Clinically-relevant hallucination rate below 2% on the provided eval set.
  3) Cost: >= 30% reduction in tokens/second cost compared to your current vendor across the same workload.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize RACI and infra access.
- Week 1: Deployment of trial model to a joint test VPC and baseline collection.
- Week 2: Run evaluation harness on your eval prompts + our regressions.
- Week 3: Performance tuning (batching, quantization) and final report.
- Goal: Conclude POC by end of March (target 2026-03-31).

Ownership / RACI (draft)
- App owner: HarborHealth - Carlos Mendez (owns integration + data routing).
- Infra owner: HarborHealth Cloud / Platform team - please confirm.
- Security owner: HarborHealth InfoSec (Nina) for access approvals and VPN/KMS.
- Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (program manager), Aditya Rao (SE lead), Dev Patel (security lead).

Action items / asks for you
1) Please confirm the internal owners for Infra, App, Security, and Procurement (names + emails).
2) Share the eval prompt set and a short sample of expected outputs (sanitized) so Aditya can craft the perf/regression tests.
3) Proc paperwork: procurement contact and any NDAs / PO templates we should expect.

I've attached a first draft POC plan and a RACI spreadsheet for you to edit. If it's easier, I'm happy to run a 30-minute RACI/roles call this week to finalize.

Thanks
Marissa
